   |
11 |     id = zeroed
   |          ^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/distinct-bare-zeroed/main.ldn:11:5

11 |     id = zeroed
   |     ^^ the place written here
  = note: [0540]/[0650]: construct it from its base, `name(0)`; a record or array holding it may be zeroed when its base has a zero image
error[L0328]: this type does not permit a zeroed initializer
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/distinct-bare-zeroed/main.ldn:15:9
   |
15 |     h = zeroed
   |         ^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/distinct-bare-zeroed/main.ldn:15:5
   |
15 |     h = zeroed
   |     ^ the place written here
  = note: [0540]/[0630]: zeroed needs a zero image for every field, and a pointer, slice, pointer union, function or atom set has none, nor does a distinct type over one; write the value with its fields, or, for a service's state, keep its references in the handle and only scalars in the zeroed state (D288)
